summary: Breakpoint week is here, and Collector Crypt owns the packs conversation: a Breakpoint teaser, a new Solana Base Set with a 1:1 card worth a $5,000 pack, an event where people pulled cards of Solana founders, and a mobile app with early Android access. Pebl launched a card you fund with Collector Crypt vaulted cards and spend with Apple Pay or Google Pay, which shows card payments around collectibles are heating up. Mainstream Pokémon talk was quieter, with the usual sold-out and scalper complaints. Solflare Packs got only a few small mentions, mostly short replies under KOL posts, plus one post on our Breakpoint merch points game.

sources_note: X search via the x connector (searchPostsAll), posts from 2026-11-15 09:05 UTC to 2026-11-16 09:00 UTC, 16 searches. Engagement numbers as returned by the X API at scan time. The Collector Crypt mobile app item comes from a third-party recap (@0x_trophy), not Collector Crypt directly. Solflare Packs mentions are mostly short replies under KOL posts and may be engagement-pod replies; low signal. JupiPacks is a token project and unverified. Skipped: Whatnot giveaway auto-posts (TCGAuction), token shills (GeneDCL, Socks), Raflux quests, off-topic 'rip'/'top shot' hits. Creators already in collector-base.csv or earlier daily files (e.g. megasigler, OliviaRue, collector1agent) were excluded.
